verdict.rationale: Auth0's RBAC docs show developers can define roles, assign permissions to roles and assign roles to users. Access-management pages also mention scopes and granular permissions for apps and APIs. The evidence never shows those roles or permissions being added as claims in issued tokens, or being enforced at authorization time. missing for 10: documented inclusion of roles/permissions as token claims, documented enforcement of permissions on API access, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can define roles and permissions and have them enforced and surfaced in session tokens for authorization checks

citations.quote: You then assign one or more roles to each user and one or more permissions to each role.
Role-based access control (RBAC) is an authorization strategy to assign permissions to users based on defined roles in an organization.
Seamlessly define access roles for your apps and APIs
Handle authorization using scopes and granular permissions, whether it's for first-party apps, third-party integrations, or Machine-to-Machine communications.
